title: OmopClinicalAlert
description: Multi-Source Windowed Clinical Patient Assessment & CDSS Alert Event

patient_id.description: Unique Patient Identifier / Medical Record Number

alert_level.description: Severity Level Indicator (e.g. CRITICAL ALERT, WARNING ALERT, PATIENT STATE)

clinical_state_summary.description: Explainable Multi-Source Clinical Assessment and Evidence Summary

total_clinical_events.description: Total clinical observations aggregated within the window

distinct_sources_count.description: Count of distinct clinical systems providing data in the window

max_systolic_bp.description: Peak Systolic Blood Pressure recorded in window (mmHg)

max_heart_rate.description: Peak Heart Rate recorded in window (bpm)

max_glucose.description: Peak Blood Glucose recorded in window (mg/dL)

max_lactate.description: Peak Blood Lactate recorded in window (mmol/L)

max_potassium.description: Peak Serum Potassium recorded in window (mmol/L)

sepsis_dx_count.description: Count of active Sepsis ICD-10 diagnoses in window

vasopressor_dispenses.description: Count of IV vasopressor medication dispenses in window

total_med_dispenses.description: Total pharmaceutical dispenses recorded in window
